text: The 'initiality conjecture' for dependent type theory (now a theorem, Brunerie-Lumsdaine-Mörtberg) states that:
choices: Every type theory has a unique model
The syntax of MLTT (or HoTT + UA) is the initial object in the category of models
explanation: The initiality theorem: the syntactic category of a type theory is the initial object among categories with the corresponding structure.
